mechanism.name: fixed 2-of-4 magnitude sparsification of young-source D21 right factors
mechanism.scope: Only the young dense-source terms in _dslices need_d21=True. D3, transports, old tier, thin legs, covariance, K4 regeneration, lambda adaptation, mean correction, and final-layer trim remain unchanged.
mechanism.rule: For each young source and each right-factor row independently, partition contraction-index j into consecutive groups of 4. Keep the two entries with largest absolute magnitude in each group; ties resolve to lower j. Rescale the two kept values by sqrt(sum(all4^2)/sum(kept2^2)) when kept energy is nonzero; otherwise keep zeros. Apply the same fixed rule separately to A and P right factors. No target, network ID, row score, or per-network parameter enters the rule.
mechanism.production_requirement: A compliant implementation must execute only the two retained values per 4-wide group in the affected D21 right-factor contractions; multiplying dense zero-filled matrices does not satisfy the cost claim.

static_cost_gate.basis: F72/F73 anatomy: 54 young dense source-pairs each cost 4 units, of which 2 units are the two D21 right-factor contractions. 2:4 arithmetic halves those 108 contraction units, a nominal 54-unit saving before O(n^2) selection/rescaling overhead.
